contradictions_forced: 806 cannot be modeled as a single boundary/closure sign. Prefix context changes its role.
Raw-perfect successor formulas are not enough: 752-615-503 shows why exact/source-family collapse is mandatory.
The 740-H-590 family cannot be called mandatory until the 740-390 and 740-405 terminal exceptions are source-adjudicated.
Ranking is metric-dependent: strict exception-free grammar favors the 060/920 and 806 candidates, while raw support and site spread make 740-H-590 competitive or stronger.

strongest_null_attack_from_sidecar.summary: Use a row-preserving maxstat over complete local rows after exact text/site/type/symbol collapse. Let every adjacent bigram choose its best exact successor or best contiguous successor window; correct over stems/windows. Add site/type/exact-cell penalties and complete-looking exception penalties. For 806, add a subset-selection null over predecessor sets before 806 and require non-Harappa holdout survival. For 740-H, correct over all 740-X heads and over the post-hoc merged head set {390,407,405}.
